items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Maybe one of Jim Robinson or something. Yes, I know.

ctx.x: I've been on quite a few sessions.
Maybe one of Jim Robinson or something. Yes, I know.
But we did make Marie Laveau with Papa's band for Joe Merez. Yes, I know. Golden Wedding, I think it's called.
